name: ente-auth
title: Ente Auth
description: Search Ente Auth TOTP accounts and copy or paste current or next codes through the Ente CLI.
author: Arduoi

commands.name: get-totp
commands.title: Get Ente Auth TOTP
commands.subtitle: ente
commands.description: Search Ente Auth accounts and copy or paste the current or next TOTP code.

commands.name: import-secrets
commands.title: Import Ente Auth Secrets
commands.subtitle: ente export
commands.description: Export the authenticated Ente Auth account and validate its local export file.

commands.name: export-secrets
commands.title: Export Ente Auth Secrets
commands.subtitle: ente export
commands.description: Create ente_auth.txt in the configured Ente CLI export directory.

commands.name: delete-export
commands.title: Delete Ente Auth Export
commands.subtitle: privacy
commands.description: Delete the local Ente Auth export file after confirmation.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Ente CLI path
preferences.description: Path to the Ente CLI binary, or leave as ente to use PATH.

preferences.name: primaryAction
preferences.title: Primary action
preferences.description: Action bound to Enter on an account, matching the Raycast extension.

preferences.name: closeAfterCopy
preferences.title: Close after copy
preferences.label: Close Vicinae after copying a code
preferences.description: Show a HUD and return to the previous window after copying.

preferences.name: transientClipboard
preferences.title: Clear codes from the clipboard
preferences.label: Clear copied TOTP codes automatically
preferences.description: Only clear the clipboard if it still contains the copied code.

preferences.name: clipboardClearSeconds
preferences.title: Clipboard timeout
preferences.description: How long a copied TOTP code remains in the clipboard.
